Connect an agent

Give Claude, Cursor or another agent access to SiteSpring in Bager Hansen ApS. You sign in with your Forspring account and approve in your browser. There is no key to copy, and you can disconnect at any time.

Choose your client

Claude Code

Run in your terminal:

claude mcp add --transport http --scope user sitespring-bager-hansen https://mcp.sitespring.app/mcp

Then type /mcp in Claude Code, pick sitespring-bager-hansen and Authenticate. Sign in and approve Bager Hansen ApS.

On a server with no browser: run claude mcp login sitespring-bager-hansen, open the link on another device, and paste back the address you land on.

Claude.ai

  1. Open Customize → Connectors and choose Add custom connector.

  2. Name: SiteSpring. URL:

    https://mcp.sitespring.app/mcp

    Click Add.

  3. Click Connect, sign in with Forspring and approve Bager Hansen ApS.

On Team and Enterprise an owner adds it under Organization settings → Connectors, then each person clicks Connect.

Other clients

Cursor, VS Code, Codex and others

Server address:

https://mcp.sitespring.app/mcp

Clients that support OAuth sign in by themselves: add the address and approve in your browser.

Add to Cursor

CLI

curl -fsSL https://sitespring.app/install.sh | sh
sitespring auth login

The CLI prints a code and a link. Open the link on any device and approve. It works over SSH and in containers too. Name the org with --org bager-hansen, SITESPRING_ORG or a .forspring.json.

Automation and CI

For a CI job or an agent that runs with no person present. A key acts as you in Bager Hansen ApS, at most as admin, until you revoke it. When a person is present, use the sign-in above.

MCP: Authorization: Bearer <key> · CLI: export SITESPRING_API_KEY=<key>

See and revoke every agent in Bager Hansen ApS
